metadata.description: Top 100 longest consecutive winning streaks in high school football history based on McKnight's database of 5M+ game records. Any loss or tie ends a streak. Data Caveat: Due to missing game logs prior to the digital era and varying state rulings on forfeits, some streak lengths may differ slightly from official state or national record books. For example, Charlotte Independence's official streak is 109 games and South Panola's is 89 games. 8-man and 9-man streaks are included where data exists. Pre-1960 records are likely incomplete — Sims (Union County, SC) had a 96-game unbeaten streak (1945-1954) and Bedford County Training School (Shelbyville, TN) went 82 games without a loss (1943-1950). Minimum 20 wins required.
